{{Quote|That fat leech down there wouldn't notice us if we were a Lekku's-length away, what with the riches being marched before him.|Voyla|<ref name="Covetous" />}}
'''Artruk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Artuk was hired by [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] member [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] to hide secret items he had acquired from the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. When the two met in Ryloth's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]], Argente presented the items to Artruk and requested that the Twi'lek store them in a secure warehouse in the [[City/Legends|city]]. During their negotiation, two Twi'leks&mdash;[[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] and [[Voyla]]&mdash;[[Spy/Legends|spied]] on Artruk and Argente and concluded that the war might find its way to Ryloth, after spotting [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. However, Syndulla and Voyla weren't the only ones spying on Artruk and Argente; the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] [[TA-175/Legends|TA-175]] and Separatist Council member [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] watched Artruk and Argente via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. After hearing Artruk's discussion about the treasures he hid on Ryloth, Tambor told his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that an [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invasion]] of Ryloth was about to commence.

==Biography==
{{Quote|It has been a profitable month for you, Magistrate. These are from&hellip;Christophsis, correct?''"<br />"''Please, dispense with titles, Artruk! I thought you specialized in anonymity.|Artruk and Passel Argente|<ref name="Covetous" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], Artruk lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="Covetous" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Artruk signed a contract that was presented to him by [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], a member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]]. Argente wanted the Twi'lek to hide secret items he had acquired from the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. The two met in Ryloth's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]], and the Magistrate showed the items to Artruk. The Twi'lek acknowledged Argente when the latter told him the items had to be confined within a secure place, and Artruk took the valuables to a nearby loading cart, soon to be inspected by two [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|pit droids]].<ref name="Covetous" />

[[File:Lessu_city.png|thumb|left|220px|Artruk and Argente met in the capital of Ryloth, Lessu]]
Using a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], Artruk calculated the amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] Argente had to pay him. After Artruk told Argente that it seemed to be a "profitable [[Standard month/Legends|month]]" for him, the Twi'lek revealed information about the items out loud, despite Argente's request for anonymity. Angered by the Twi'lek's behavior, Argente told Artruk he was only going to pay him to erase any connection he had with the items. During their negotiation, two Twi'leks&mdash;[[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] and [[Voyla]]&mdash;spotted Artruk and Argente in the warehouse. The pair [[Spy/Legends|spied]] on them on top of the warehouse's ceiling support beams and saw [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] near Artruk and Argente, leading them to conclude that the Clone Wars might come to Ryloth.<ref name="Covetous" />

They weren't the only ones spying on Artruk and Argente, however.<ref name="Covetous" /> [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|Tactical droid]] [[TA-175/Legends|TA-175]]<ref name="LoR">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode021.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> and Separatist Council member [[Emir/Legends|Emir]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] watched both Artruk and Argente via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. When Tambor heard Artruk discuss his hidden treasures on Ryloth, he asked TA-175 if Ryloth was one of their targeted worlds; the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] revealed that it was "target number seventy-nine." Tambor then ordered the droid to mobilize their [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and change Ryloth's priority number from seventy-nine to one.<ref name="Covetous" /> With Tambor, the Confederacy [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invaded]] Ryloth and established a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] around the planet.<ref name="SoR">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Honored Magistrate, I welcome you to Lessu, city of riches. I see that you add to our wealth. We are honored.|Artruk, to Passel Argente|<ref name="Covetous" />}}
Artruk's only desire was to help those who had riches in their possession, and he was referred to as a "fat leech" by Voyla. When he was contracted by Argente, the Twi'lek didn't hesitate to help the Magistrate, and met with him in Ryloth's capital of Lessu, which Artruk called the "city of riches." When Argente wanted his items to be hidden within a secure location, Artruk told him that his warehouses were the securest ones in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Artruk also specialized in anonymity, which pleased Argente. Despite his promises of anonymity, the Twi'lek spoke of the item's origins out loud, angering Argente. Artruk had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin.<ref name="Covetous" />

==Behind the scenes==
Artruk first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Covetous]]'', a six-page [[Star Wars comic books|online comic]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic series]], which led directly into "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]," the nineteenth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="sor">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode019.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref>
